params.tune: Base pitch in semitones. This is the pitch at Track 0; note tracking transposes it relative to middle C, so 60 with Track at 1 plays exactly the note you press.
params.punch: Attack character: depth of the fast pitch sweep, plus the click layer on top of it. This is most of what separates a thud from a kick.
params.drop: Depth of the slower pitch fall into the fundamental. Small is tight, large is the classic 808 dive.
params.decay: How long a hit lasts, in seconds. Short for driving, long for hypnotic and dub.
params.drive: Saturation amount. At 0 the voice is clean whichever Curve is selected.
params.tone: Tilts the spectrum before the drive, so it decides what gets distorted. Down is dark and round, up is mid-forward and cutting. 0.50 is flat.
params.dirt: A band-passed noise layer above the fundamental. The grain that survives distortion.
params.volume: Final output level. At 0.00 it mutes the voice.
params.track: How much the note played moves the pitch. 0 is a fixed-pitch kick, 1 follows the keyboard for toms and sub-bass.
params.sweep: Scales both pitch-envelope times together. Fast is a click, slow is a dive.
params.shape: Amp decay curve, exponential through to linear. Exponential sounds natural, linear sounds tighter and more abrupt.
params.phase: Oscillator start phase on each trigger. Starting at the waveform peak hits harder than starting at a zero crossing.
params.curve: Drive character: 0 Soft, 1 Asym, 2 Clip, 3 Fold, 4 Crush.
params.body: Oscillator waveform, sine through to triangle. Triangle brings out upper harmonics for toms and rubbery bass.
params.vel_depth: How much velocity moves level, pitch-envelope depth and drive together.
params.human: Per-hit variation in pitch, decay, drive and level, so consecutive hits are not identical copies.
